description: This file contains implementation of functions related to defining and managing toolchains and tools within a build system, including functions for running toolchain definitions, configuring tools, and handling tool variables.

classes.name: Toolchain
classes.description: Represents a build toolchain with associated commands, dependencies, arguments, and configuration options.

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a build tool with specific command and output configurations.

methods.name: RunToolchain
methods.description: Defines and registers a new toolchain based on the provided scope, function call, arguments, and block.

methods.name: RunTool
methods.description: Defines a tool within a toolchain, configuring its command, outputs, and other properties.
